name: FFS_PLANNED_WORK_TIME_LOG
description: Stores a modification history for the corresponding parent table.

columns.name: PWTIME_LOG_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies log record of planned working time changes.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Who Column: Time in GMT when action was performed.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Who Column: Identifies user the operation is performed by. Zero value means internal application task. Points to USER_ID in FFS_USER.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to RESOURCE_ID in FFS_RESOURCE.

columns.name: MEASURE
columns.description: Defines measure unit of planned value.

columns.name: PLANNED_DATE
columns.description: Date when planned value is defined for.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: New planned value according to measure unit.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE
columns.description: Old planned value according to measure unit.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
